Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Tesla paid just 4.9% of their profits in federal corporate taxes in 2025.

They've seen their collective tax bill drop by $95B thanks to two rounds of Trump tax cuts.

Meanwhile, tech layoffs in 2026 have already surpassed 2025.

Trickle-down economics was always a scam.
